description: Long panel with grooved line ornament. One section is rectangular, thicker by half, pierced sideways through the width midway. The top part extends beyond this section, cut obliquely to the width of the tenon on one end (0.9 wide, 0.5 thick and max.0.9 long), cut off at an angle. At opposite end the central panel between grooves, which is equal to the tenon, continues unbroken to the second similar section, worked symmetrically; the gap forms a regular semi-hexagonal open space, possibly for receiving a suitable panel fitted sideways. All edges except for the broken end are clean, well cut. Decoration consists of parallel grooves, shallow and gentle, setting off the side edges and emphasizing the central zone. Crosslines, thinner and fainter, are marked across this central zone marking the edge of the thicker section and parallel on the opposite side, set apart approx. 2 cm, which would also be the anticipated width of cross-panels, same as this panel.
